messages:
marta: quick thread 1: need speaker bios + two social captions for next week's webinar. also deciding on CTA AB test (cost-review vs private-trial).
diego: ok. speakers locked: priya (product narrative), kyle (benchmarks), marta (customer story). order preference?
kyle: i'd go product -> benchmarks -> customer so context before numbers.
priya: fine by me. i'll update my 2-line bio for the register page.
marta: promo copy idea #1 (short): "See how teams cut inference costs without sacrificing latency. Join Redwood engineers for a practical walkthrough."
asha: promo copy idea #2 (hook): "When models scale, serving wins. Learn the levers teams use to reduce cost-per-inference. Live demos + QA."
diego: both good. let's make two social captions for an AB ad test: caption-A use the 'cost' hook, caption-B use 'reliability' hook. keep under 240 chars.
kyle: caption-A: "Slash token costs and keep your SLAs. Join our engineers for a 40-min playbook on inference economics + live demo. Register now."
priya: caption-B: "Keep LLM apps online during demand spikes. Practical strategies, fallbacks, and a live demo. Save your seat."
marta: nice. Landing page hero copy draft: "Predictable inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." subhead: "Benchmarks, customer demos, and a hands-on checklist to lower unit costs."
diego: landing form fields need HubSpot mapping. kyle, can you paste the JSON payload we'll test with vendor staging?
kyle: sure, posting small example (sanitized): ```json
{
  "firstName":"Test",
  "lastName":"User",
  "email":"test@example.com",
  "company":"Acme",
  "attend_type":"enterprise",
  "company_size":1200,
  "interest":"private_trial"
}
```
asha: mapping notes: firstName->firstname, lastName->lastname, email->email, company->company, attend_type->hs_attend_type, company_size->company_size, interest->custom_interest. will add as property mapping in the doc.
priya: on CTAs: i vote for lead quality over volume. cost-review CTA mapped to sales-opps pipeline; private-trial should be gated and routed to partner-engage.
diego: agreed. let's AB test primary CTA on registration confirmation email too.
marta: run-of-show short version for producers: ```
00:00 - 00:03 host intro (diego)
00:03 - 00:12 product narrative (priya)
00:12 - 00:22 benchmark walkthrough (kyle)
00:22 - 00:30 customer story (marta)
00:30 - 00:40 demo (kyle)
00:40 - 00:55 live q&a (panel)
```
kyle: demo prep note: we'll present two micro-benchmarks (latency p50/p95) side-by-side. need a screenshot for the slide in case live endpoints glitch.
asha: we should also prepare a fallback GIF recorded locally and embed as backup. producers can swap if demo fails.
priya: speaker bios (2-line) - draft: "Priya Shah, Product Lead @ Redwood Inference. Leads model-serving UX and product for Dedicated & Private offerings."
marta: mine: "Marta Lopez, Head of Customer Success. Works with enterprise teams to optimize inference cost and reliability."
kyle: mine: "Kyle Hwang, Senior ML Engineer. Focused on inference kernels, batching strategies, and quantization tradeoffs."
diego: good. social handles? add if you want them on the speaker card.
priya: yes pls add mine @priyainfra
kyle: @kyle_h
marta: skipping mine.
webinar-bot: recording enabled, auto-trim silence ON, captions ON.
asha: rehearsal schedule (final): tech canary Tue 10am PT, full-run Wed 9am PT, dress rehearsal Thurs 8am PT. please confirm availability.
marta: all confirmed except thurs (out afternoon)
kyle: ok for all slots
priya: canary conflict tuesday morning, can do full-run and dress.
diego: will re-run canary myself then. producers: we need a 2-hour block to QA registration->hubspot flow after canary. who owns?
asha: i'll own registration QA. will publish test results to the drive and the #greenroom channel.
marta: what about attendee segmentation in the follow-up? can we append a property for webinar-interest to support nurture flows?
asha: yes, adding hs_webinar_interest property with values: cost_review, private_trial, general.
kyle: technical QA checklist for producers: 1) demo creds rotated, 2) fallback GIF ready, 3) KV warmup script added (run at T-1m), 4) pre-spin extra GPU node at T-5m, 5) captions verified.
diego: action items: asha publish mapping + QA results, kyle export benchmark screenshots + demo GIF, priya final bio + slides, marta customer slides + talking points. lock at EOD friday. :lock:
priya: will update slides tonight.
marta: i'll update talking points and send to diego by tomorrow noon.
webinar-bot: Reminder scheduled: full-run rehearsal Wed 9:00am PT (automated).
asha: posting ad variations to the ad-ops channel in 15m for approval.
diego: perfect. any blockers? if none, we call this plan locked. :white_check_mark:
marta: no blockers. excited to see attendees. :confetti_ball:
